title: Hue, Thua Thien Hue — Cost of Living, Housing & Relocation Guide [2026]
description: Complete guide to Hue, Thua Thien Hue: cost of living, home prices, neighborhoods, remote work readiness, and relocation tips.
content:
Overview

Hue is a city in Thua Thien Hue with a population of 350,000. Vietnam’s former imperial capital, home to the UNESCO-listed Citadel and royal tombs, offering a slower pace of life and very affordable living in a historically rich setting. Housing is more affordable than the national average. The overall cost of living is below the national average. Gardening thrives here — the 7a growing zone supports Mild — wide variety of vegetables, many fruit trees. Reported crime rates are relatively low. The population skews young, with a median age of 32.0.
